title: OpenAI’s progress number: from GPT-3.5 to the window it says comes next
intro: Slide through the log-perplexity figures OpenAI’s chief scientist published. Lower means the model predicts text better. Each step shows what he says appeared at that level.
note: All figures are OpenAI’s own, measured on a held-out sample of its internal codebase, as written in Jakub Pachocki’s post; most are approximate (“~”). They cannot be compared with other labs’ numbers, which use different data. The 0.68–0.7 window is his extrapolation, not a measured model. Perplexity does not capture gains from step-by-step reasoning.
